Scale colour, and derive fill by blending (discrete)

Source: R/scale-blend.R
scale_colour_blend_discrete.Rd

Scales colour with a discrete colour scale, and additionally maps fill to a blended version of the resulting colour, via aes_colour_blend(). The fill legend is suppressed since colour already communicates the mapping.

Usage

scale_colour_blend_discrete(blend = NULL, ...)

Arguments

blend

A function that takes a colour vector and returns a blended colour vector.

...

Additional arguments passed on to ggplot2::scale_colour_discrete(), and ggplot2::scale_fill_discrete().

Value

A list of ggplot2 components (a mapping, a discrete colour/fill scale, and a guide) that can be added to a ggplot object.
